referenceFramework.name: SGPC Sikh Rehat Maryada Article IV with five-bani morning practice documented separately
referenceFramework.policy: Name the actual edition and practice scope. Do not quietly replace a community variant with another tradition's composition.
referenceFramework.scopeDisclosure: Article IV English SGPC morning explicitly lists Japji, Jaap and Ten Savaiye; the familiar additional morning Chaupai/Anand is tracked as a broader five-bani practice, and neither practice is silently equated with the other.
referenceFramework.variantDisclosure: SGPC narrow Rehras has six ordered components; online Rehras pages can include extra verses outside this exact sequence. Benti Chaupai scope differs across recitation traditions, so 25- and 29-pauri digital variants are separately named and pending independent authoritative edition review.
